India ki coaching industry ₹2 lakh crore ki hai. Aur iske 4 sabse bade naam aaj mushkil mein hain. Byju's bankrupt ho chuka hai. $22 billion ki company literally zero pe aa gayi. Unacademy ko upGrad ne kharid liya, woh bhi peak se 90% neeche valuation pe. Physics Wallah ka IPO ₹145 pe aaya tha, aaj stock ₹83 ke aaspaas hai. Aur Khan Sir ne ₹107 crore ka offer reject karke sab kuch government exam prep pe tikaa ke rakha hai, bina kisi backup plan ke.
Iske upar NEET ka paper leak hua. Supreme Court ne bola ki yeh undisputed fact hai. 70 exam leaks 7 saal mein. Students ne ₹30 se 50 lakh diye paper kharidne ke liye. Aur ab AI aa raha hai jo poori coaching industry ko disrupt karne wala hai.
Is video mein maine sab kuch investigate kiya hai. Kaun sach mein students ke liye kaam kar raha hai, kaun empire bana raha hai, aur 5 saal baad iss industry mein kaun bachega.
Sab kuch verified hai. Numbers, court filings, public data, stock prices. Yeh opinion nahi hai, yeh research hai.
